#   juce_add_plugin(VocalStrip
#       ...

#   )
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP B: Binary data target for UI resources
#
# juce_add_binary_data embeds all UI files into a static library that is
# linked into the plugin. BinaryData.h / BinaryData.cpp are auto-generated.
#
# File layout expected under Source/ui/public/:
#   index.html                     (copy from v6-ui.html)
#   js/juce/index.js               (copy from JUCE frontend lib)
#   js/juce/check_native_interop.js (copy from JUCE frontend lib — pattern #13)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
juce_add_binary_data(VocalStrip_UIResources
    SOURCES
        Source/ui/public/index.html
        Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js
        Source/ui/public/js/juce/check_native_interop.js
)

# If any additional assets exist (fonts, images, extra CSS), add them here:
# Source/ui/public/fonts/SomeFont.woff2
# Source/ui/public/images/logo.png

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP C: Link UI resources and juce_gui_extra to plugin target
#
# Append to the EXISTING target_link_libraries() call for VocalStrip.
# Do NOT duplicate the target_link_libraries() call.
#
# Example (merge into existing call):
#   target_link_libraries(VocalStrip
#       PRIVATE
#           VocalStrip_UIResources     # <- add
#           juce::juce_gui_extra       # <- add (enables WebBrowserComponent)
#           juce::juce_audio_processors
#           juce::juce_audio_utils
#           ...
#   )
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_link_libraries(VocalStrip
    PRIVATE
        VocalStrip_UIResources
        juce::juce_gui_extra
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP D: Compile definitions — enable WebView, disable CURL
#
# JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1   : enables WebBrowserComponent
# JUCE_USE_CURL=0      : disables CURL (not needed for local HTML resources)
#
# Append to the EXISTING target_compile_definitions() call for VocalStrip.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_compile_definitions(VocalStrip
    PUBLIC
        JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1
        JUCE_USE_CURL=0
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP E: juce_generate_juce_header (pattern #1 — JUCE 8 requirement)
#
# MUST come after target_link_libraries(), BEFORE target_compile_definitions().
# If already present in CMakeLists.txt, do not add a second call.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
juce_generate_juce_header(VocalStrip)
